reviews.title: Path to Freedom
reviews.text:
Relay has provided a much needed resource of not only content learning surrounding addiction recovery, but deeply necessary community, connection, and transparency that is deeply healing.  I have found the analytical tools provided for observing and learning my own patterns and points of weakness absolutely invaluable, and they continue to make the resources better every day.  This coupled with group therapy through one of the providers who filmed content available in the app has made a powerful and inseparable combo for my own recovery journey.

I have been on an intensive with the creator of the app, and they clearly take their work very seriously, and making this app a powerful and effective recovery tool is clearly extremely personal to them!

So thankful for the literal Godsend of the whole relay team, their listening ears to the needs of the community using the app, and all the work they put in to making this an incredible resource.

Download it, and invest in your own recovery work.  You get out what you put in!

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time
reviews.text: This app/program uses highly inefficient methods to try and break free from addiction. I was in it for over 6 months, and all it did was make me feel guilty, shameful, inadequate and give me zero solid direction towards actually making a meaningful change. These methods only reinforce helplessness, and will keep you stuck on the hamster wheel of addiction. I quit Relay because I found another program that actually teaches you how to rewire you neural pathways. Not only did I quit porn through the other program, but weed as well. And I did it without having to put blockers on any device, TRUE FREEDOM is possible, but not with this app/method.

The issue though is the cost for me, which I feel is really high ($99 a year). There are also live meetings, but that costs another $199 a year (which I feel should be included). It’s a great app and support is really nice, but unfortunately the price drives me away, especially as a student.

reviews.text:
This app has been really powerful and amazing. I wish I had found it years ago. The learning modules are very, very information-dense and packed and actionable. Knowledge is power, truly. reviews.title: Very hopeful
reviews.text: This is what I hope to be the turning point of my journey. I’ve struggled my porn/sexual addiction for most of my life. It’s 2026, I’ll be 36 in august. I hope that through Relay, I can finally hit the reset button on my life with nothing to hold me down.
